stories.title: Gavin Newsom Mocks 'Golden Age of Super Intelligence,' Calls President’s 'Let It Rip' Approach to AI 'Reckless'
stories.simple_summary: California's Governor Newsom criticized the President's relaxed approach to AI regulation, saying it's reckless and not a 'golden age of superintelligence.'
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly political disagreement — nothing you need to act on right now.

stories.title: Trump taps Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton as AI czar: WSJ reports
stories.simple_summary: The President appointed Jay Clayton to lead the government's AI policy and decisions.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly affects how the government will regulate AI companies — it could change rules for your business down the road, but nothing immediate.

stories.title: Don’t Write With AI , Say People Who Write With AI
stories.simple_summary: Writers who use AI tools are now saying other people shouldn't use AI for writing.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're thinking about using AI to help write, people have mixed opinions, but it's ultimately your choice depending on what you need.

stories.title: Amazon responds to data center backlash, says it no longer uses NDAs
stories.simple_summary: Amazon said it will stop using secret agreements (called NDAs) that prevented people from talking about its data centers.
stories.why_it_matters: This means more transparency about how Amazon's AI data centers work, but it probably won't directly affect your business.

stories.title: Capcom is preparing for a ‘future where we create games together with AI’
stories.simple_summary: The video game company Capcom said it plans to use AI to help create games in the future.
stories.why_it_matters: This only matters if you work in gaming — it doesn't affect everyday people or most small businesses.

stories.title: OpenAI safety employee resigns, claiming the company’s ‘culture is broken’
stories.simple_summary: An employee at OpenAI who worked on safety quit his job because he says the company's workplace culture has serious problems.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech workers — it doesn't directly affect your daily life or business.

stories.title: Splice CEO Kakul Srivastava thinks AI emails are killing conversations
stories.simple_summary: The CEO of a music production company says AI-written emails are making real conversations between people less common.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a business, this is a gentle reminder that AI emails might hurt your actual relationships with customers and partners.

stories.title: An OpenAI safety employee has quit and is sounding the alarm
stories.simple_summary: A former OpenAI safety expert published an article warning about dangers at the company after he resigned.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech workers — it doesn't directly affect your daily life or business.

stories.title: All the AI agents that can live in your text messages
stories.simple_summary: There are now AI assistants you can chat with right in text messages for things like planning trips or organizing work.
stories.why_it_matters: These are tools you could try if you want text message help with tasks, but they're optional — you don't need them to run your life or business.

stories.title: An A.I. Songwriting Experiment: Humans Against the Machine
stories.simple_summary: The New York Times tested an experiment where humans and AI competed at writing songs.
stories.why_it_matters: This is just an interesting experiment — nothing you need to do or worry about.

stories.title: Meta wants your next gadget to be Muse-infused
stories.simple_summary: Meta (Facebook's parent company) is offering free AI technology so other companies can add AI features to TVs, toasters, and other appliances.
stories.why_it_matters: Eventually you might see AI in more household gadgets, but this is mostly important for companies that make these products, not for shoppers.

stories.title: Opinion | Cartoon by Matt Davies
stories.simple_summary: The Washington Post published a cartoon, but no headline details are given.
stories.why_it_matters: Without knowing what the cartoon is about, we can't say what it means.
